plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Anthropic's feature-dev workflow plugin. Vendored copy, re-reviewed against upstream before each update.

plugins.name: wikijs
plugins.description: MCP server for Wiki.js — manage wiki pages via the Wiki.js GraphQL API.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Task-routed development agents on explicitly pinned models: read-only architect on Fable 5, builder on Opus 5, operator on Sonnet 5, scout on Haiku 4.5. Agents and commands only, no hooks or MCP server.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server, pinned to @playwright/mcp 0.0.79 with headless/isolated Chromium flags.

plugins.name: plane
plugins.description: Plane's official MCP server, pinned by image digest (v0.2.11) and run as a hardened rootless container. Requires Plane 1.4.1+; token from ~/.plane-mcp/env, workspace from a per-project .plane-workspace file.
